svg.title: Raygen Rupe — Engineer. Student. Maker.
svg.desc: Oversized cream and lilac lettering frames Raygen Rupe's SERV0 3D printer on a dark aubergine background.
svg.metadata: Origin: composed by scripts/generate-social-card.mjs in the approved concept 26 visual style, with Raygen Rupe's unmodified SERV0 assembly render, sourced from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lordbagel42/Serv0/main/Images/Serv0.png. Archivo and Manrope are the self-hosted Google Fonts in static/fonts. See static/projects/SOURCES.md for attribution and the source render's CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.
